notFound: That idea is not in this matrix.
chooseAnother: Choose another stage above to bring it back.
assumptionHint: What must already be true about what other people do or pay for. One sentence you can check.
assumptionPlaceholder: e.g. People on my street already lend tools to each other a few times a year.
needsMoreEvidence: That needs more in the evidence log first.

evidence.title: Evidence log
evidence.none: No conversations recorded yet. Confidence stays at 1 or 2 until one is.
evidence.noBehaviour: No current behaviour recorded, so this entry does not count toward Confidence.
evidence.what: What do they currently do about this problem?
evidence.whatPlaceholder: Past and present only. What they said they would do does not count.
evidence.commit: What did they commit to, if anything?
evidence.commitPlaceholder: Money, an introduction, a pilot, their time. Leave empty if nothing.

parkDialog.title: Park “{{name}}”
parkDialog.description: Parking keeps the idea, its scores and its evidence as history, and takes it out of the matrix. A sentence on why is required, so you remember later.
parkDialog.placeholder: e.g. Two conversations showed people are happy with what they use today.
parkDialog.deleteInstead: Added by mistake? Delete it instead
